items.q: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
items.a: Usually an overloaded circuit, a short or a failing breaker. A licensed electrician can test the circuit and tell you which one it is.

items.q: Is a warm or sparking outlet dangerous?
items.a: It can be. Stop using it and have it checked. Heat and sparks are signs of a loose connection or damaged wiring.
